latestVersion.changelog:
Free-free-maker 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Create and export videos for free with no watermark or cost, using cloud GPU processing.
- Simple onboarding: automatic token fetch, session setup, and status updates ("Connecting...", "Ready!").
- Support for uploading video/audio/image files up to 500MB; handles MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more.
- Natural language actions: edit, generate, export, check credits, and view timeline state with easy commands.
- All exports are watermark-free 1080p MP4; rendering happens remotely in 30–90 seconds.
- Clear error handling and step-by-step session management for a smooth, paywall-free video creation experience.
